labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks whether it is doing it wrong or a bug; behaviour follows documented no_wrap/wrap rules. Related to #2890.

items.body:
Columns wrap by default, and `overflow` only decides how text is cut when it does not fit, so the first attempt wraps rather than ellipsizes. Your second attempt with `no_wrap=True` is the documented way to get ellipsis. Column options are listed in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst

The other columns being squashed is related to #2890, which reports `no_wrap` squashing columns below their `min_width`. Setting `min_width` on the other columns may help in the meantime.

For how-to questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
